description: Canonical stage → B2 basenames for purge, dispatch, and ops. Aligns with contracts/stage_artifacts.json, scripts/ops_stage.py, supabase/functions/ops/stage_outputs.ts.

notes.normalized.mp4_bwf: Valid-frames cut only (court-visible keep-ranges via NCC on corners); not full broadcast
notes.normalized.mp4_user: Full video re-encode ≤1080p/30 H.264; audio kept when present (AAC)
notes.preprocess-log.json: SSOT for frame_shifts, timings, worker fingerprint, validated annotation (corners+net_poles), source/output probes
notes.audio: Kept on both paths when source has audio; never product-stripped
notes.path_mode: YouTube input_url → bwf court cut; otherwise → user full encode

optional: scoreboard_crop / score_sub_crop / row_split_y (detect OCRs into detections.json segments[])
labels[] click anchors + display_name (analyze identity later; not detect ReID today)
annotation.worker_gate: Missing/unusable corners or net_poles → normalize job fails

bwf.matches_row: Already from match-data catalog; harness enqueues only (upsert=false)
bwf.source: matches.source_url (yt-dlp each attempt) or staged original.mp4 for non-YouTube

user.matches_row: Created at matches-ingest confirm after original.mp4 upload

mvp.detect_content: detections.json Engine envelope: fps/width/height, segments[], rallies[], frames[] (pose + shuttle) for every frame of normalized.mp4
mvp.workers: normalize and detect on vast.ai serverless; analyze not wired

failure_modes_to_distinguish: missing net_poles / corners → normalize failed callback
no NVENC / no GPU → normalize fail
callback wire success|failed vs DB complete|failed
B2 artifacts present but job still processing (callback settle failed)
YT BWF retries re-download source_url (do not require original.mkv on B2)
